scope.flow: HypoVault share accounting bootstrap: constructor pre-sets totalSupply with zero underlying assets, then first deposit fulfillment mints shares against a near-zero totalAssets denominator
scope.environment: HypoVault vault contract (Solidity, Math.mulDiv share math)

statements.text: The HypoVault constructor pre-sets totalSupply = 1 000 000 while the vault owns zero underlying assets.
Before the first fulfilment, computeNAV() == assetsDeposited, so totalAssets == 1.
For the very first deposit, sharesReceived should equal assetsToFulfill.
Later depositors buy worthless shares; their funds are effectively stolen.
